source_title: How Is The Additional 20 Pro Discount Applied

snippets.snippet_text: "The additional 20% PRO discount is applied directly to the courses, you don't have to do anything! As it is additional, you can use another promotion or discount code in your order. Then, in your shopping cart, you will see the final price of your order and the information on each discount in a detailed way. Please note that the PRO discount is not added to other discount percentages, but rather the PRO discount is applied to the current course price."
